t: The Turbo mixed screws trade case offers high-quality, multi-purpose woodscrews for reliable fastening in professional and domestic projects. Engineered for durability, these heat-treated carbon steel screws reduce snapping risk. Their double self-countersunk head features underhead ribs for a flush finish, removing the need to counterbore. A wax-coated surface ensures smooth insertion, speeding up work on wood, plastic, masonry, and thin sheet metal. The sharp, deep thread cuts cleanly, while the rifled shank minimises splitting when driving close to edges. Supplied in a stackable plastic organiser case, it provides a practical storage solution for workshops or on-site use.
b: Deep, Sharp, Single Thread for Cutting Cleanly through Wood
For Wood, Plastic, Masonry & 1mm Sheet Metal
